Splitify for Android (Android 8.0 / API 26 or later). Installs as an update over any earlier version; your data stays in your Google account.

## What's new
- New transparent app logo across the app: launcher icon, splash screen, header, login page and notifications.
- Includes everything from v1.6.1: search from Home (events and items, including hidden events), hide/unhide events, and phone notifications while the app is open or in the background.

## Install
Download **Splitify-v1.6.2.apk** below and open it on your Android device.
